traits.anchorage_per_stem_kg.note: fgr 2020 (ForestGALES), species parameters for Sitka, Norway, white and black spruce: C_reg 167 N m per kg of green stem, the mean over its four soil groups and three rooting depths and over those species, from tree-pulling tests (Nicoll et al. 2006 and others, listed in the Critical Resistive Moments vignette). A species with its own pulling tests states its own.

traits.crown_drag_at_rest.note: fgr 2020 (ForestGALES), species parameters for Sitka, Norway, white and black spruce: crown drag coefficient on the silhouette Cd = C u^-N with C 2.35, N 0.51, fitted between 10 and 22 m/s (means over those species), after Mayhead's (1973) wind-tunnel drag of whole trees and later studies (Streamlining and Drag vignette).

traits.note: Abrams (vol. 1, 1923, p. 61), Picea: leaves spirally set and standing out on all sides of the twig, each on a woody peg, kept 7 to 10 years; seed cones hang and ripen in their first autumn, shed whole with their scales.
